decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-444 MODIFY recording the 3.3V LED supply, direct ESP32 data drive, revised threshold, elimination of the level shifter, and removal of obsolete level-shifter component attributes.
Moving the LEDs from 5V to 3.3V does not change the requirement to monitor both rails or the number of spare monitoring channels.
The candidate already has a message-444 MODIFY adding the SK6812 LEDs to the loads supplied by the standalone 3.3V rail.
The LED supply-voltage change does not affect the panel button connector, PWRON signal, mounting, or switching behavior.
The AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power source and the system still requires both 3.3V and 5V rails because the 5V sensor loads remain.
The source does not change the configured DCDC1 output, downstream 3.3V target, rated current, or Schottky-drop compensation rule.
Changing the SK6812 electrical supply and data interface does not change the required charge-status indication path, connector, resistor, or population choices.
The LED supply change has no effect on the battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, accessibility, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or thermal protection requirements.
The source does not change ESP32 clocking, sleep modes, deep-sleep policy, or wake sources.
The interboard interface must still carry both 3.3V and 5V because the 5V sensor loads remain; the source does not change connector topology or pinout.
The LED electrical-interface change does not modify the interboard signal connectors or pinouts, and 5V_EN remains applicable to the retained switched 5V sensor rail.
